entities.summary: Daniel Reed Crenshaw is an American politician and former United States Navy SEAL officer serving as the U.S. representative for Texas's 2nd congressional district since 2019. He is a member of the Republican Party. Dan Crenshaw was a military leaders & commanders from Aberdeen (b. 1984-03-14, Aberdeen). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to geopolitics.
